decisions.note: Edit covers url/title/notes but never mentions description field; client's blanket acceptance missed the gap.
Only title is auto-collected on save; description, favicon, and preview image (required by REF-BM-02) are absent, unnoticed by client.
Tags feature ships with no autocomplete on entry; not raised by either side.
Search is plain substring match over url/title/notes; no description coverage, #tag syntax, boolean/parenthesised operators, or quoted-phrase exact match — client accepted as-is.
No mention of duplicate-url-to-existing-bookmark handling; re-saves likely create new rows, unchallenged.
Maker declares the build 'Done... tested end-to-end' with no unread/read-later state, bulk actions, or sorting; client's 'covers what I wanted' affirms completeness despite these core omissions.
